name: Party Identification 35 Choice
definition: Choice of identification of a party. The party can be identified by giving a BIC or a proprietary code.

BIC.name: BIC
BIC.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution, eg, Dun & Bradstreet Identification.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to a financial institution using a proprietary identification scheme.
